mapper.select: SELECT thd.TR_DT FROM T_TR_HIST_DETAIL thd INNER JOIN T_CONT_MST cm ON cm.CONT_NO = thd.CONT_NO AND cm.PT_TYPE_CD = 'MILEAGE' WHERE thd.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND thd.CONT_NO = #{contNo} AND thd.TR_GB_CD = 'S001' AND thd.BEF_BAL_PT = 0 AND thd.TR_SNO < #{trSno} ORDER BY thd.TR_SNO DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY thd.TR_SNO DESC, thd.TR_SEQ DESC) ROW_NUM ,thd.TR_SNO ,thd.TR_SEQ ,thd.CONT_NO ,thd.MEMBER_NO ,AES_DECRYPT(FROM_BASE64(mm.MEMBER_ID_ENC) , ei.ENC_KEY) AS MEMBER_ID ,thd.PT_NO ,thd.MEMBER_PT_NO ,thd.TR_DT ,thd.TR_GB_CD ,thd.TR_METHOD_GB_CD ,thd.TR_PT ,thd.BEF_BAL_PT ,thd.AFR_BAL_PT ,thd.CONT_BEF_BAL_PT ,thd.CONT_AFR_BAL_PT ,thd.ORGL_TR_SNO ,thd.REG_USER_ID ,thd.REG_DT ,thd.LAST_MOD_USER_ID ,thd.LAST_MOD_DT FROM T_TR_HIST_DETAIL thd INNER JOIN T_MEMBER_MST mm ON mm.MEMBER_NO = thd.MEMBER_NO INNER JOIN T_ENC_INFO ei ON ei.TARGET_GB_CD = 'ORG' AND mm.ORG_NO = CONVERT (ei.TARGET_VAL, INT) WHERE 1 = 1 AND (thd.TR_SNO = #{trSno} OR thd.ORGL_TR_SNO = #{trSno} ) ORDER BY thd.TR_DT DESC, thd.TR_SNO DESC, thd.TR_SEQ DESC
